# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. All of this is read from code. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay out of the whole site, and the pages are built only in the browser. The one unknown is the canonical address (the "official" URL of each page), because the code doesn't say which domain is yours. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every search and AI crawler not to read any page, so the site can't be found however good it is. This is the only blocker in the report, and it affects two rules (GEO-009 and GEO-014). - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59 (was 24–33). I assumed you want to be found. If the block is deliberate, for example on a staging site, ignore this item. ### 2. Put page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** `index.html` ships an empty `
`, and the text only appears after JavaScript runs. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see an empty page. The catalogue is also fetched in the browser. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large (prerender or server-render the pages, e.g. with a static-generation plugin or a framework) - **Score after this:** 37–46 on its own (was 24–33). ### 3. Give every page a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Every page currently shows the same generic title, and there's no description or `lang` attribute, so machines can't tell the pages apart. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small to Medium (the site-wide default is a one-line fix; per-page titles need a head helper such as react-helmet) - **Score after this:** 33–41 on its own (was 24–33). ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and a sensible size | Clear | `public/robots.txt`, 2 plain valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers can get in | Problem | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks `*` site-wide | | GEO-014 | Pages can be indexed | Problem | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks Googlebot and Bingbot via `*`, 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical URL | Can't tell | No canonical set and no domain declared; tell me your domain | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | `index.html:8` empty root, no prerender, 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD in the repo | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is listed | Problem | No sitemap file, and no `Sitemap:` line in robots.txt | | GEO-012 | Title, description, `lang` | Problem | `index.html:2,5`, shared by both routes | | GEO-016 | Key pages reachable by real links | Problem | `src/main.jsx:11`, catalogue is a button using `navigate()` | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict | Clear | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet:0` found | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Problem | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` image has no `alt`; Catalogue is fine (1 of 2 routes) | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not present, and not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Catalogue contents depend on an API call in the browser:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6`: `fetch('/api/mugs')`. Mug names appear only after the fetch resolves. Render them on the server or at build time. ## Worth considering - **Make the catalogue link a real link:** `src/main.jsx:11`: ``. Replace it with ``, so crawlers can follow it. This is also the GEO-016 fix. - **Describe the hero image:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add `alt` text saying what the image shows. - **Give each mug its own page:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `

{m.name}

`. Each mug is just a name. A `/catalogue/:id` page with description, price and photo would give people and machines something to read and cite. - **Back up the shipping claim:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: "shipped worldwide". Say where you ship, how long it takes and what it costs. - **Label the business in structured data:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: "Thrown by hand in Bristol". Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD with the name, location and links would state this in a machine-readable way. - **Add `viewport` and social tags:** `index.html:4-5`: only `charset` and `title` are set. Add `` and Open Graph tags (`og:title`, `og:image`). - **Add a sitemap with dates:** no sitemap exists. Once one does, include `` for each page. - **Link onward from the home page:** `src/pages/Home.jsx` has no link into the catalogue. A link in the body text would help both visitors and crawlers. - **Make the catalogue page say what it is:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:10`: `

Catalogue

` is vague. Something like "Handmade ceramic mugs, catalogue" would be clearer. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** no canonical is set and no domain is declared. Tell me your site's domain and I'll treat it properly. - **GEO-011 (sitemap):** a sitemap is missing, so I can't say what the right URL list is. The mug list comes from `/api/mugs`, which isn't in this repo. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI tools to find this site (there's no `geo.config.json`). - The `Disallow: /` isn't a deliberate staging block. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
